# MetrAIyux 0S True Copy-Paste Dev Sauce · Expanded v2

This package extends the corrected true copy-paste vault.

## Added in v2

- 48 new individual inline SVG icons under `copy-paste/expanded/icons-inline/`
- 28 new standalone copy-paste UI blocks under `copy-paste/expanded/components/`
- New live route: `copy-paste/expanded/index.html`
- New all-in-one HTML bundle: `copy-paste/expanded/snippets/METRAIYUX_EXPANDED_COMPONENTS_ALL_IN_ONE.html`
- New expanded inline icons HTML bundle: `copy-paste/expanded/snippets/METRAIYUX_EXPANDED_ALL_INLINE_ICONS.html`
- New CSS token kit: `copy-paste/expanded/snippets/metraiyux-expanded-standalone-kit.css`
- New React icon registry: `copy-paste/expanded/snippets/MetrAIyuxExpandedIcons.jsx`
- New vanilla JS icon registry: `copy-paste/expanded/snippets/metraiyux-expanded-icons.js`

## Copy-paste rule

The expanded blocks are designed to paste directly into a plain HTML document. Components include their own scoped styles and inline SVG. No `/assets/icons/...` path is required for the expanded components.

## Logo rule

The real transparent MetrAIyux 0S logo asset remains in `assets/metraiyux-0s-logo-transparent.png`. The expanded component kit does not substitute or invent a new logo.
